I will vote to end the filibuster.

Republicans are abusing it to block voting rights & endanger our democracy. To block health care & child care & union protections.

We have to win this Senate seat to end the filibuster.

I can win & help get it done. It's that simple. #PASen https://t.co/lJSEkXVM8Z

Counterpoint: here's a list of 11 bills that Democrats have actually passed, that I've ALREADY voted for & could pass if we win in PA:

1. John Lewis Voting Rights Act
2. Freedom to Vote Act
3. Women's Health Protection Act
4. Build Back Better
5. Raise the Wage
6. PRO Act

Yesterday the Senate GOP & Sen. Manchin blocked the Women's Health Protection Act.

I voted for it in the House & I'll be one more vote in the Senate to make it law, guaranteeing the right to choose no matter what the court does.

We can win that vote in PA this November #WHPA

Stopped at Enon Tabernacle Baptist Church today for their Know Your Number Event to kick off Minority Health Month. 

Thank you to Reverend @DrAlynEWaller for having me and for hosting this great event. https://t.co/6mlhrOmr31

Visited senior centers across Westmoreland County this morning. 

While the republicans promise to cut Social Security and Medicare, I’m campaigning on raising social security payments and expanding medicare to include dental, vision, and hearing coverage. https://t.co/axsH8oV4Nr

Solidarity forever with @CWAUnion, @Teamsters, @AlleghenyLabor and all union workers fighting for the fair pay and health care they earn every day. @PittsburghPG needs to give up on union busting and do the right thing.

Seniors in western PA have been asking me for 5 years to lower their Medicare premiums. This year, under the Biden administration and a Democratic House and Senate, it’s happening.

That really matters to people, and it’s going to matter on Tuesday. https://t.co/PgcwLyZ04d

-Lowest unemployment in 54 years 
-Highest # ever of Americans with health insurance
-Biggest Social Security raise in years 
-Cut the deficit 

That's what Biden has done.

I've worked alongside Cindy, and it is exciting and refreshing to see such an accomplished public servant rise to a critical position for the health of our democracy.  

Congratulations Cindy!

To those asking, but what have you done?  

Thanks to @JoeBiden, Medicare premiums went down this year for the first time in a decade.  

That alone left seniors with more Social Security $, and then benefits went up by $140 per month.

Trump never did that.  The GOP never will.

Another fact: Medicare premiums are often deducted by Social Security, so when the premiums went down, seniors got even more money.

This happened because of @JoeBiden's efforts to cut Medicare's costs, like the cost of prescription drugs.

“Some of the things that she laid out in that speech — the child tax credit, extending health care subsidies — all that kind of stuff is just universal,” Mr. Lamb said. “That should do as well in Rochester as it does in the heart of the city.” https://t.co/DonVZ6P2Ie

It would be nice to see media coverage of these ridiculous speeches include easily attainable facts, like the largest coal plant in Pennsylvania shut down while Trump was president. https://t.co/xPnY9iN6A4

RFK will be fine and safe under Trump, while he gambles with the future of people who will lose their health insurance and be forced to work into their 80s under Trump’s policies.  They may well lose the influence of their vote.

You lost. Take it like a man.  Don’t do this.

You know, Trump and the “pro-life” crowd doubling down on such a cruel abortion ban reminds me … not a single one of them ever lobbied me to support the child tax credit, automatic health coverage…the things new moms and babies actually need for life.  Funny how that works.

By the way, to show DOGE people how crazy this is: This lab worked with a local manufacturer and health system during COVID on alternatives to disposable N95s.  A huge private sector need!  That they helped an American company meet against Chinese competitors!  Nuts to fire them

Give me 2 mins to tell you about the 5 hospitals in PA at IMMEDIATE risk of closing.  All in GOP districts.   
These people deserve a voice.  No they did not vote for this.  Let's save these hospitals. https://t.co/g0DDhF1XGM

No more navel gazing or infighting.  We now have a clear task.  Inform blue collar America Trump once again failed them.  Let’s stand on wooden crates at tractor pulls and ask for the chance to go back in and save people’s healthcare, paid for by higher taxes on Trump and Musk.

Did Trump promise Pennsylvania he’d raise healthcare costs on bartenders and part-time cops by 19%?  By 13% on small businesses?  That our power companies would seek the highest prices ever?

Of course not.  His promise to lower prices is broken in PA.  https://t.co/UJdfHkx6CQ

When does the populism start? 
You guys do know charging more for Medicare is going to be really unpopular right?

The Trump/Vance/Abbott gerrymandering is despicable but don’t let it get you down too much.  The secret helicopter guy, who ran against stock trading and constantly trades stocks, is going to get fired for taking healthcare from people and there are similar examples all over.
Oh and the new jobs we’re adding are in sectors like education and healthcare that are directly threatened by all of Trump’s cuts to Medicaid, schools, etc.  Just an awful recipe for Pennsylvania.

This is doubly true now that Trump is saying he won’t negotiate with “sick” Democrats after what happened.  He’s simply wrong about blame for this horrific crime and 150k people in my state could lose their healthcare over it.

The Pennsylvania insurance commissioner just predicted the cost of an ACA plan will go up *82%*!  Affects 500k people whose budgets are already stretched to the breaking point.

Yet neither of our senators seems aware.  The radical left didn’t cause this one fellas.

https://t.co/yyeZreCaGC

(Pennie is our ACA market) https://t.co/AJ1B2u1G3Y
